searchText: It looks like one of the attestation tests, "empty_aggregation_bits", in v0.11.1, compared to v0.11.0, was broken. The post-state file is missing, making empty attestations look invalid, while they were previously considered valid (maybe they should not be though?). Has anyone else stumbled on this? At the same time, it also looks like the attestation signal in that test has gotten zeroed out, instead of being a valid but empty signature. So test can still pass fine as an "invalid case", but not for the reason I intended. Let me know if anyone has experienced any issues. I will look into fixing this for next release Update: test can pass for now, so you can ignore as implementer. We found the culprit in test generation, and we are looking into related edge cases.
